event_text: Malicious access to Decathlon customer data at an outside provider, according to Decathlon
Four files said to come from Decathlon are posted on a hacking forum
notes: Clubic dates the posting to the night of Sunday to Monday.

event_text: Decathlon confirms the malicious access to Ouest-France
France 3 Hauts-de-France publishes Decathlon's confirmation, given to it directly
